title: MoE-RBench: Towards Building Reliable Language Models with Sparse Mixture-of-Experts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the harmfulness of model responses to prompts designed to elicit hate speech, discriminatory language, and controversial content (using datasets like CoNa and Do-not-answer) through automated safety predictors including a Reward Model, Llama Guard, and the OpenAI Content Moderation API.

Measuring out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness by evaluating the model's performance on sentiment analysis tasks when the input text undergoes stylistic transformations, such as being rewritten in the style of Tweets, Shakespeare, Biblical text, and Poetry.
